summary: Stale command-menu classification hid Ponyta's queued Double Kick
symptom: After Rock Tomb, the adapter reported command_menu while field mode 34 and a stale switch/task boundary still owned input. A voluntary switch cursor move was rejected; after the queue drained, RAM showed Onix fainted and the forced party selector active.

authoritative_evidence.queued_result: Ponyta Double Kick hit 2 times; Onix fainted

root_cause: Battle menu inference accepted a command-menu signature before the final queued opponent action and forced-faint transition had drained.
fix: At any post-action boundary, require stable active battler identity, HP/PP, drained battle text, and no active field tasks across repeated reads before allowing a voluntary switch. Use the forced party selector when field mode 13 is authoritative.
recovery: Continued forward using the forced selector; no save-state rewind was used.
